# has lyricist

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasLyricist`](gmeow-hasLyricist.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasLyricist>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a creative work to the agent who wrote its lyrics. Flat shortcut subproperty of [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)
**Sub-property of:** [`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasLyricist`](gmeow-hasLyricist.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:hasContributor`](gmeow-hasContributor.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of naming a lyricist — the agent who wrote a song's words.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the credit's period, degree, or evidence must be first-class (promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) with [`gmeow:roleLyricist`](../individuals/gmeow-roleLyricist.md)), and avoid it for the composer of the music ([`gmeow:hasComposer`](gmeow-hasComposer.md)) or a librettist (use [`gmeow:roleLibrettist`](../individuals/gmeow-roleLibrettist.md)).

### How to use

- Assert from the song or musical work to the agent; promote to a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) carrying [`gmeow:roleLyricist`](../individuals/gmeow-roleLyricist.md) when metadata is needed.

### Examples

- ex:song [`gmeow:hasLyricist`](gmeow-hasLyricist.md) ex:bernieTaupin.
